signal: Matroid continues expanding its no-code computer vision platform into manufacturing and industrial IoT, a market where enterprise pipeline coverage is the constraint

Rob, Matroid pushing no-code computer vision deeper into manufacturing and industrial IoT means a wide enterprise target list across plants and operators.

That breadth usually means more accounts in play than an enterprise team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Matroid off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Rob, quick follow-up for Matroid.

Enterprise computer vision has long cycles, so the addressable list of manufacturers grows faster than a lean team can work it, and strong accounts sit untouched for months. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Matroid needs to fill the enterprise funnel this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
